advancement.createsprings.pse_dash.desc:
use steam dash while using steam dash

advancement.createsprings.spring_age.des: Use Spring Alloy to create a casing for 1 recipe and decoration
block.createsprings.spring.tooltip.behav: _Throws_ player holding the item in the _opposite_ direction
If the player _holds_ the spring, it _converts_ part of the damage into _charge_, reducing fall damage
block.createsprings.spring.tooltip.summa: As an _item_, if has _charge_ can _throw_ entities
block.createsprings.spring_alloy_block.t: _spring alloy_ in form of a block
_Casing_ for mechanisms that use the properties of _spring alloy_
create.spring.stopped: it looks like the spring can't move further because of non breakable blocks
createsprings.ponder.analog_latch.text_1: Analog latch outputs selected redstone signal on activation
createsprings.ponder.analog_latch.text_2: Output signal can be configured using value panel
createsprings.ponder.analog_latch.text_5: By clicking on the block, analog latch switches to the reverse mode
createsprings.ponder.catapult.text_1: Sneak and Right-Click holding an Spring Catapult to select its target location
createsprings.ponder.catapult.text_2: The placed Catapult will now launch objects to the marked location
createsprings.ponder.catapult.text_3: A valid target can be anywhere with in range of 100 blocks
createsprings.ponder.catapult.text_4: If no Target was selected, it will do nothing
createsprings.ponder.catapult.text_5: Items placed in the catapult cause it to trigger
createsprings.ponder.catapult.text_6: Supply Rotational Force in order to charge it
createsprings.ponder.catapult_second_tar: Sneak and Right-Click holding an Spring Catapult to select its main target
Sneak and Right-Click Two times to select its second target
After receiving or shooting items catapult will switch targets
createsprings.ponder.explosion.text_1: When an explosion occurs near the spring, spring receives some charge
createsprings.ponder.explosion.text_2: if spring doesn't face the explosion, it explodes
createsprings.ponder.explosion.text_3: spring can be charged even by explosions in water
createsprings.ponder.kinetic_interface.t: Springs on contraptions can be tricky to access
This component can interact with springs without the need to stop the contraption
Place a second one with a gap of a block inbetween
While engaged, the stationary interface will represent ALL springs and large springs on the contraption
If stationary interface is rotating, springs on contraption will charge
If stationary interface is powered it will generate energy using charge of the springs on the contraption
createsprings.ponder.large_spring.text_1: To construct large spring place a 3*3 square of Large Spring Coils
createsprings.ponder.large_spring.text_2: All placed coils should face the same direction
createsprings.ponder.large_spring.text_3: Add hollow rings of coils to make spring longer
if any block in the spring is powered large spring will start releasing stored energy
Speed of generated rotation depends on the signal strength
Large spring mode can be switched by clicking with tripwire hook to the center of the first layer
createsprings.ponder.spring.text_1: Springs are able to store rotational force
createsprings.ponder.spring.text_2: The direction of rotation does not matter
createsprings.ponder.spring.text_3: When powered, the spring will slowly release stored energy
createsprings.ponder.spring.text_4: The speed of generated rotation depends on signal strength
createsprings.ponder.spring.text_5: The charging rate can be changed by configuring spring stiffness
createsprings.ponder.spring.text_6: By default spring adapts it's stiffness in order to maximise efficiency
createsprings.ponder.spring_sable.text_1: that content is available only if Sable(Create Aeronautics) is installed
createsprings.ponder.spring_sable.text_2: in splash mode springs are able to push sub levels
createsprings.ponder.spring_sable.text_3: if spring is on sub level it pushes it
createsprings.ponder.spring_sable.text_4: equal impulses will be applied to both sub levels
createsprings.ponder.spring_sable.text_5: on sub levels spring can split and shoot blocks in front
createsprings.ponder.spring_sable.text_6: if spring collides with enough speed it splashes
createsprings.ponder.springsplash.header: Using rotational force stored in springs
createsprings.ponder.springsplash.text_1: The spring mode can be switched by clicking on block with Tripwire Hook
createsprings.ponder.springsplash.text_2: By clicking on spring with empty hand mode switches back
createsprings.ponder.springsplash.text_3: In splash mode spring instantly releases stored energy on activation
createsprings.ponder.springsplash.text_4: Springs are able to push entities...
createsprings.ponder.springsplash.text_6: to break block spring needs enough charge
createsprings.ponder.springsplash.text_7: springs do not break mechanisms and pressure plates
createsprings.ponder.welding.text_1: friction welding is another way to process blocks
createsprings.ponder.welding.text_2: when they rotate with enough speed and there is blocks between welders, welding will start
createsprings.ponder.welding.text_3: Welding speed depends on the speed difference between welders
createsprings.pse.tooltip.5: increasing the speed of spring tools
createsprings.pse.tooltip.fuel: a slot for _fuel_, you can put any _furnace fuel_ in that slot
createsprings.pse.tooltip.overdrive: when _overdrive_ is turned on _PSE_ will work with maximum speed, but _pressure_ in engine will constantley _rise_, When _pressure_ hits _100_ engine _explodes_
createsprings.pse.tooltip.overdrive2: you will be able to do _steam dash_ or _stem release_ when pressure is high enough to lower pressure but it is a _temporary measure_
createsprings.pse.tooltip.water: when there is _no water_ in the engine, _PSE_ will try find _water bucket_ in the _inventory_ if it finds _water bucket_ inner tank will be _restored_ and water bucket _wouldn't be spent_
createsprings.punchcard.action.title: Instructions for current executor:
createsprings.punchcard.executor.title: Executors:
createsprings.punchcard.name: Name:
createsprings.punchcard.tooltip.action: Here you can _select_ the instructions that the tools will _execute_, the first instruction is the _condition_ under which the punchcard will be _activated_
createsprings.punchcard.tooltip.executor: Here you can _select_ the tool that will _execute_ the punchcard, some tools have _special capabilities_ that can be _activated by the punchcard_
item.createsprings.broken_portative_stea: _mechanism_ that has been subjected to _improper use_, despite the damage, _can be repaired_
item.createsprings.explosion_chamber.too: R-click with a _spring_ and _fuel_ in the chamber
item.createsprings.hat.tooltip.summary: A _hat_. can be _placed_ on the ground and also can store _1 stack_ , if engineer _goggles_ are stacked on top it will function as engineer _goggles_
item.createsprings.molten_spring_alloy_b: a viscous, hot liquid with a metallic color, strangely, it _doesn't harm_
item.createsprings.portative_steam_engin: Does _Steam Dash_ when the _pressure_ level is high enough, Also reduces the _pressure_
Ejects _hot_ steam that _ignites mobs_ in front of the player, reducing _pressure_
A small _Steam Engine_ capable of _charging_ tools, lighting the way, and also _warming_ and _accelerating_ players
item.createsprings.punchcard.tooltip.beh: if punchcard is in a tool and it is _waiting for activation_, the next _instruction_ will be executed _instantly_
item.createsprings.punchcard.tooltip.con: When stacked on a suitable tool
item.createsprings.punchcard.tooltip.sum: Can _program_ some tools, can hold a _small amount_ of commands
Incredibly _elastic_ material, resistant to _explosions_, has a low melting point, cannot be _compressed_ with a press
item.createsprings.spring_base.tooltip.c: When a spring is _stacked_ on the tool
item.createsprings.spring_base.tooltip.s: A Base for _spring-powered_ tools, can hold up to _2 springs_, to transform it into a spring tool stack a _modifier_ on top
Instantly releases the spring _charge_ in the tool, converting it to _extreme_ speed
When a spring is stacked on the tool
R-click with a tripwire hook in the tool

item.createsprings.spring_fan.tooltip.co: When a spring is stacked on the tool
R-click with a tripwire hook in the tool
item.createsprings.spring_fan.tooltip.su: A _portable_ spring-powered _Fan_, Can hold up to _2 springs_, pushes entities _to_ or _from_ the player, direction changes when _Shift_ is pressed, Works on _elytra_
item.createsprings.spring_launcher.toolt: When a spring is stacked on the tool
R-click with a spring and a tnt in the launcher
A _powerful_ weapon that can _fire springs_ or _spring alloy blocks_, scope can be added by _placing a spyglass_ inside

R-click with a tripwire hook in the tool
item.createsprings.spring_saw.tooltip.su: A _spring-powered_ saw, Can hold up to _2 springs_ Harvesting _speed_ depends on the _tool's speed_

item.createsprings.sus_package.tooltip.s: This package when _dropped_ from a height or _destroyed_, releases a _spring_ that bounces off _blocks_ or _entities_
